payload.title: Keep feed item identities stable across published updates
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a subscriber, I want published revisions to retain article identity, so that my reader updates an existing item without creating duplicates.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Keep feed item identities stable across published updates
  Scenario: Revise a published article
    Given an article already appears in RSS and Atom with a stable item identity
    When its headline, body or canonical slug is changed and published
    Then its RSS GUID and Atom entry ID remain stable
    And its current canonical link and meaningful published update time are returned
    And repeated generation does not create duplicate entries
  Scenario: Withdraw a public article
    Given an article has appeared in public feeds
    When it is unpublished
    Then future served feeds exclude it within the documented freshness bound
    And private replacement drafts never substitute for it
```

Readers may retain previously fetched content; withdrawal cannot promise deletion from third-party caches. Preserve original publication time separately from update time.
